# seis-pozo (ORM, docs/SEIS_BLOQUES_11_20.md, PLAN_100 F14, box 6 of block 16. Pozo de Kakariko (de niño) y Dead Hand):
# one game and five bots. A warps into BottomOfTheWell (Well_KakarikoSide, child) and walks its key rooms with
# place (recorridos_adulto.py's); the bots (seis-pozo.bots.txt) come in from KakarikoVillage_Child after it
# and follow it 3 m off. In the first room A falls and bots 3 and 4 lift it; then bot5 sends a room's flag
# (A's game takes it 0 -> 1) and bot1 goes down, bot2 lifts it.

mark start
warp BottomOfTheWell Well_KakarikoSide child
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark llegada
wait 1200               # the five bots follow A into BottomOfTheWell
mark r01-vestibulo      # the first hall
place 0.10 107.00 34.40
wait 300
mark caida              # A falls here: bots 3 and 4 come and hold A beside it
life 0
wait 2400               # their 3.5 s and the game's 6 s revive
mark levantado          # then bot5 sends the flag and bot1 goes down, bot2 lifts it
wait 600
mark r02-puerta07       # the locked door of room 07

wait 300
wait 900

wait 900
